method: TinyFish search, US/en, 12 cluster-level queries chosen to map intent across all 64 slugs

competitorTypes: AI generators (Pixelbin, Fotor, Phygital+, Media.io, Somake, Framearto, easy-peasy)
titlePatterns: AI {Style} Filter — Turn Your Photo Into ...
vibes.intent: Mixed: people want either (a) a custom commission they wait days/weeks for, or (b) a free/cheap AI filter. Almost nobody offers AI + printed deliverable.
vibes.ourAngle: AI generated from your selfies in minutes, no perfect family photo needed, optional printed card. We compete on speed + family-anchored composition + physical deliverable.

competitorTypes: Print-on-demand giants (Minted, Vistaprint, Walmart Photo, Shutterfly, Walgreens, Paper Source, Paper Culture, Simply to Impress, Pear Tree, CardsDirect, Artifact Uprising, Hallmark, Postable, Zazzle)
cards.intent: Transactional. Searchers already have a family photo and want a printable card. They are price- and design-shopping.
cards.ourAngle: We generate the family-perfect photo for you. No 'who is wearing what, get everyone smiling, hire a photographer' marathon. Card design + AI family photo in one flow.

anchorQueries: oil painting family portrait from photo
competitorTypes: Hand-painting commission services (Paint Your Life, PortraitFlip, MyDavinci, Welham & Co, Instapainting, SchulmanArt, Leon Loard)
styles.intent: Gifting and home decor. People wait 2-4 weeks and pay $89-$1000+ for hand painted commissions.
styles.ourAngle: Same hand-painted look, generated in minutes for a fraction of the price. Optional printed deliverable.
